result.summary: Found 2 minor issues related to inconsistent tag placement and low-contrast secondary text, with no critical or major visual breaks on the page.

issues.description: Inconsistent placement of information tags across restaurant cards: cards in the 'Fastest near you' section have time tags anchored to the bottom-left of their images, while the card in the 'Popular right now' section has its delivery fee tag anchored to the top-left of its image, creating a disjointed visual layout.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the position of all card information tags (time, delivery fee, offers) to a consistent location (e.g., top-left or bottom-left) across all card sections for a unified, polished appearance.

issues.description: Secondary text (delivery fees, order time ranges, restaurant categories) uses a light gray color against a white background, which likely fails WCAG 4.5:1 contrast requirements, reducing readability for users with low vision or in bright lighting.
issues.suggestion: Darken the gray secondary text color to meet WCAG contrast guidelines, ensuring this content is easily readable for all users.
